en: The front of the postcard shows a historical black-and-white image of a town square bordered by grand civic buildings. A monumental church with a large clock tower dominates the background, with other 19th-century public buildings around an open, tree-lined plaza. There is handwritten text in Swedish at the bottom and printed text indicating location and landmarks. The reverse has sections for address and message, with writing in Swedish, including a stamp cancellation that mentions 'Sundsvall.'
